SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞衛生部於今年7/7宣佈爆發疫情,該國8個省份自今年1月以來累計報告108例疑個案(含3例確定病例),由於該國實驗室檢驗量能不足,須送往澳洲進行檢驗,可能低估實際傳播情形。另病例地理分佈無流行病學關聯,且該國疫苗覆蓋率低,預期疫情擴散。 巴西今年截至7/31,累計報告18例確定病例,主要集中於首都聖保羅(15例)之2歲以下與20-50歲族群。此波疫情為該國獲得消除麻疹認證後,首次出現持續性本土傳播,主因為該地區為重要樞紐,且近期世界盃結束後人潮返國及7至8月學校假期等因素。該國已針對特定地區擴大疫苗接種對象為6個月至59歲族群,防止疫情向外擴散。 美洲地區疫情持續,自今年截至7/25,共17國/地區累計報告4 萬7,026例確定病例及48例死亡(CFR:0.10%),病例數較去年同期增加5倍。其中,高達97%確定病例集中於瓜地馬拉(30,040例)、墨西哥(12,233例)、美國(2,318例)及加拿大(1,107 例)。
SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.en: Papua New Guinea's Ministry of Health declared an outbreak on 7 July this year. Across 8 provinces, 108 suspected cases (including 3 confirmed) have been reported since January this year. Because the country's laboratory testing capacity is limited, samples must be sent to Australia for testing, which may underestimate the actual spread. In addition, cases are geographically dispersed with no epidemiological links, and vaccination coverage is low, so the outbreak is expected to spread. As of 31 July this year, Brazil has reported 18 confirmed measles cases, mainly in the city of São Paulo (15 cases), among children under 2 years and people aged 20 to 50 years. This is the first sustained local transmission since the country was certified as having eliminated measles. The main factors are that the area is an important hub, the return of travellers after the recently concluded World Cup, and school holidays in July and August. Brazil has expanded vaccination in specific areas to people aged 6 months to 59 years to prevent the outbreak from spreading further. Measles activity in the Region of the Americas continues. As of 25 July this year, 17 countries and territories have reported a cumulative 47,026 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (CFR: 0.10%), a five-fold increase over the same period last year. As many as 97% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Guatemala (30,040), Mexico (12,233), the United States (2,318) and Canada (1,107).

sSGfCo8Hdi5E4sG8tnhkXg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/23-29期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為查德2例、剛果民主共和國/奈及利亞各21例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦6件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為馬拉威/奈及利亞各1件。 澳洲西部珀斯(Perth)於4月中旬檢出 1 件cVDPV2環境樣本,基因定序與近年於非洲、歐洲及巴布亞紐幾內亞檢出之病毒相近,因當地疫苗覆蓋率達92%,且無社區傳播跡象,當局評估風險為非常低,推測可能為旅外人員將病毒排泄至汙水系統。另該國最近 1 例人類案例係發生於1972年。
sSGfCo8Hdi5E4sG8tnhkXg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 23 and 29 April, cVDPV2 added four cases across three countries: two in Chad, and 21 each in the DRC and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added six specimens in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added two specimens across two countries, one each in Malawi and Nigeria. In mid-April, one cVDPV2 environmental sample was detected in Perth, Western Australia. Its genetic sequence is similar to viruses detected in recent years in Africa, Europe and Papua New Guinea. Because local vaccination coverage reaches 92% and there are no signs of community transmission, authorities assess the risk as very low and speculate that the virus may have been excreted into the sewage system by someone who travelled abroad. The country's most recent human case occurred in 1972.

j_lKeLCnvvYzMb-Zsg-naw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於11/27-12/3期間,cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為剛果民主共和國2例、安哥拉1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增2國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞7件、查德2件。
j_lKeLCnvvYzMb-Zsg-naw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 27 November–3 December that cVDPV2 added 3 cases in 2 countries: 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Angola. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 9 samples in 2 countries: 7 in Papua New Guinea and 2 in Chad.

5dNk7QZ9HbVP89bVZ5qAHw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/23-29期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增3國共10例,分別為奈及利亞7例、安哥拉2例、巴布亞紐幾內亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦12件,cVDPV2新增5國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞5件、安哥拉/查德/奈及利亞/索馬利亞各1件。
5dNk7QZ9HbVP89bVZ5qAHw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 23–29 October, WPV1 added one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 added 10 cases across three countries: 7 in Nigeria, 2 in Angola and 1 in Papua New Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 12 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added 9 samples across five countries: 5 in Papua New Guinea, and one each in Angola, Chad, Nigeria and Somalia.

ZNPDwjghOUjpusfxfHTvkA.zh: WHO西太平洋區3國病例數急遽增加,斐濟過去10年新增感染病例上升10倍,主要感染途徑為注射毒品,另有傳播至其他太平洋島國之疑慮;菲律賓自2010-24年新增感染病例增加6倍,主要感染族群為男男性行為者;巴布亞紐幾內亞宣布愛滋病毒感染為國家危機,以應對育齡婦女和兒童族群不斷上升之感染率。WHO及聯合國已召開會議,以因應該區愛滋病危機,並探討解決行動方案。 印度東部賈坎德邦柴巴薩市某醫院於10月爆發5名地中海貧血兒童,經輸血感染愛滋病毒事件,首例於9/13接受輸血,5週後(10/18)檢測陽性,經調查5名病患血型不相同,顯示為多名捐血者血液遭汙染,感染源調查中,另該院血庫與實驗室有多項違規事項,當局已宣布該院血庫僅提供緊急情況使用。
ZNPDwjghOUjpusfxfHTvkA.en: WHO's Western Pacific Region reports sharp increases in case numbers in three countries. In Fiji, new HIV infections have risen tenfold over the past 10 years, mainly through injecting drug use, and there are concerns about spread to other Pacific island countries. In the Philippines, new infections increased sixfold between 2010 and 2024, mainly among men who have sex with men. Papua New Guinea has declared HIV a national crisis to respond to rising infection rates among women of reproductive age and children. WHO and the United Nations have convened meetings to address the regional HIV crisis and discuss action plans. In India, at a hospital in Chaibasa city, Jharkhand state in eastern India, five children with thalassaemia were infected with HIV through blood transfusions in October. The first child received a transfusion on 13 September and tested positive five weeks later, on 18 October. Investigation found that the five patients had different blood types, indicating that blood from several donors was contaminated. The source of infection is under investigation. The hospital's blood bank and laboratory were found to have multiple violations, and authorities have announced that the hospital's blood bank will only provide blood for emergencies.

w4HYdVJDCbWLMdETCIO7nA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-9期間,WPV1新增阿富汗2例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增2國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞7件、查德2件。
w4HYdVJDCbWLMdETCIO7nA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 3–9 October, WPV1 added two cases in Afghanistan. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added nine samples across two countries: seven in Papua New Guinea and two in Chad.

g8I3gjnuCs8GJ-d8-dIeWA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/28-9/3期間,WPV1新增2國共4例,分別為巴基斯坦3例、阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增4國共5例,分別為安哥拉2例、查德/奈及利亞/巴布亞紐幾內亞(前已掌握)各1例。
g8I3gjnuCs8GJ-d8-dIeWA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 28 August–3 September, wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) increased by four cases in two countries: Pakistan (3) and Afghanistan (1). cVDPV2 increased by five cases in four countries: Angola (2), and Chad, Nigeria and Papua New Guinea (1 each; previously identified).

PVeE2qlcwZbV7YHCsUiaOw.zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞莫雷貝省(Morobe)萊城(Lae)8/28報告1例cVDPV2病例,病患為4歲男童,出現急性無力肢體麻痺後確診;該地區前於4月起陸續檢出cVDPV2環境樣本,5月報告2例無症狀cVDPV2案例,當局正加強疫苗接種及監測措施。
PVeE2qlcwZbV7YHCsUiaOw.en: In Lae City, Morobe Province, Papua New Guinea, one cVDPV2 case was reported on 28 August. The patient is a 4-year-old boy, confirmed after acute flaccid paralysis. The area had detected cVDPV2 environmental samples since April, and two asymptomatic cVDPV2 cases were reported in May. Authorities are strengthening vaccination and surveillance measures.
